scientific_limitations: Requires a finite non-interacting FLRW fluid mixture with constant equations of state and nonnegative density fractions.
Excludes components with \(-1/3<w_i<0\), interacting or time-varying components, negative density fractions, and inhomogeneous cosmologies.
The numerical example is a sanity check only; the result is established analytically.
title: Unique nontrivial redshift-drift zero for standard FLRW mixtures
